title: Dale City Winter Farmers Market
name: Dale City Winter Farmers Market
description:
At the winter market you can find high quality honey, produce, as well as prepared and ready to eat foods, freshly baked breads, and sweet treats. There are hardy greens, winter squashes, apples, sweet potatoes, and other root vegetables.
This is the time of year to enjoy slow roasted meats and veggies, stews, chili, and hearty soups. Get out your roasting pan, stew pot, and slow cooker. Soon the aroma coming from your kitchen will be irresistible!
No animals are allowed at both markets with the exception of service animals.
https://pwcparks.info/farmersmarket
14090 Gemini Way, Dale City
Dale City Farmers Market
Since 1987, Dale City Farmers Market has been at the forefront of serving Prince William County residents. With nearly the 50 vendors in the summer and 30+ in the winter, is one of the largest open-air markets in the region.
Winter Market, December 2025-March 2026: 10am-1pm
Spring/Summer/Fall Market, April-November, 2026: 8am-1pm
Note: Closed Easter Sunday

title: The Ritual of Mask Making: Play, Performance, and Self-Permission Workshop
name: The Ritual of Mask Making: Play, Performance, and Self-Permission Workshop
description:
In this workshop, participants will create a face mask, allowing Veterans and their adult family members to express their emotional journeys through art. Creating masks provides a symbolic way to explore and represent inner emotions, offering a tangible outlet for processing the complexities of trauma and recovery. The workshop will also encourage participants to share their stories through mask creations and accompanying personal reflections. Led by Steven Luu, U.S. Air Force Veteran, recent MFA graduate and artist in George Mason University's School of Art, this workshop is open and FREE to Veterans, Servicemembers, military family members, and military caregivers ages 18 and older. Space is limited.
Please reference our information sheet for details, including minimum age requirement and community policies regarding Veterans and the Arts on-site workshops. More information about the on-site workshop will be provided to registrants by email.
